newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Vranitzky drops plans to visit south Albania.
newsitem.headline: Vranitzky drops plans to visit south Albania.

text.p: International mediator Franz Vranitzky will not travel to the rebel-held southern Albanian city of Vlore on Thursday as originally planned, a spokeswoman for the Organisation of Security and Cooperation in Europe said.

Melissa Fleming said on Wednesday evening in Tirana that Vranitzky wanted to focus his attention during his two-day trip to Albania on political issues in the capital city. The decision came after Vranitzky met President Sali Berisha.
"He wants to focus on the situation here and focus on preparing for elections," Fleming said.
She said Vranitzky would visit the south on a subsequent trip. Vranitzky has urged the government and rebel leaders to start talks to pave the wave for elections by June.

Vranitzky, on his third trip as the OSCE envoy to violence-stricken Albania, planned to visit Vlore in the south and Shkoder in the north on Thursday. But the planned visit was criticised by newspapers close to President Berisha.

Demonstrators outside a meeting between Vranitzky and Prime Minister Bashkim Fino had also criticised the former Austrian chancellor for his plans to visit local authorities in the south, largely controlled by rebel committees since February.
